metadata.name: Masochist Class Tree
metadata.description: Single continuous web. The Path of Suffering runs up the centre and is what fills Fervour from health lost. Flesh Craver upper-left, Blood Tithe upper-right, Flagellant lower-left, Low Life lower-right. Keystones sit at the far end of each limb and need full investment in their parent. The four vow capstones are the 25/50/100/200 point tiers and stand apart from the web.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Health you lose generates Fervour: 1 per 1% of maximum health lost to damage, and 1 per 1% of maximum health spent as an ability cost. While you have this, healing removes Fervour at the same rate, 1 per 1% of maximum health restored, so your health regeneration is what empties it rather than a timer.

data.name: Pain Tolerance
data.description: +1% increased Maximum Health and +0.5% increased Armor per point.

data.name: Willing Flesh
data.description: +2% increased Health Regeneration per point.

data.name: Cataclysmic Resonance
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for 5 seconds after you take damage of a Cataclysm type other than Demonic.

data.name: Brutal Determination
data.description: +2% increased Life Leech per point.

data.name: Echoes of Agony
data.description: Damage taken from damage over time effects is reduced by 1% per point.

data.name: Open Wounds
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health lost to damage per point.

data.name: Blood Price
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

data.name: Scar Tissue
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Hardened Nerves
data.description: +2% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point.

data.name: Retributive Instinct
data.description: +3% increased Retaliation per point.

data.name: Communion of Pain
data.description: While your Fervour is at maximum you deal 20% more damage and take 20% more damage.

data.name: Sanguine Ledger
data.description: Health regeneration no longer removes Fervour, but your Health Regeneration is reduced by 50% (multiplicative).

data.name: Reciprocity
data.description: Your Retaliation damage is increased by 1% for each point of Fervour you currently hold.

data.name: Iron Hide
data.description: +3% increased Armor per point.

data.name: Bulk
data.description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point.

data.name: Reprisal
data.description: +3% increased Retaliation per point.

data.name: Vicious Onslaught
data.description: +1% increased Attack Damage per point for every 5% of your maximum health that is missing.

data.name: Blood Offering
data.description: Taking physical damage grants a stack of Bloodlust for 5 seconds, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased melee physical damage per point.

data.name: Thirst for Pain
data.description: While you are Bleeding, +2% increased Attack Speed per point.

data.name: Battle-Scarred
data.description: +2% increased Armor per point for each unique debuff on you.

data.name: Undying Hunger
data.description: +3% increased Life Leech per point.

data.name: Mutilation Mastery
data.description: Your melee critical strikes have a 5% chance per point to apply Bleeding.

data.name: Gorge
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health lost to damage per point.

data.name: Unflinching
data.description: +2% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point.

data.name: Carnage
data.description: Killing an enemy while above 75 Fervour grants a stack of Carnage for 8 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Each stack gives 3% more melee damage.

data.name: Wounds That Feed
data.description: Healing from Life Leech does not remove Fervour.

data.name: Flesh Craver
data.description: You gain 30% more Fervour from health lost to damage, and 50% less Fervour from health spent as an ability cost.

data.name: Stigmata
data.description: +2% increased damage over time damage per point.

data.name: Lingering Hurt
data.description: +2% increased damage over time duration per point.

data.name: Penitent
data.description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point.

data.name: Endurance in Suffering
data.description: For each unique debuff on you, +1% increased damage and +0.5% increased Damage Reduction per point.

data.name: Wound Channeling
data.description: Damage from debuffs on you is increased by 1% per point, and you deal 1% increased damage per point to enemies carrying a debuff you also carry.

data.name: Symphony of Pain
data.description: Debuffs on you last 2% longer per point, and their effect on you is reduced by 1% per point.

data.name: Contagious Torment
data.description: When a debuff on you deals damage, enemies within 6 metres have a 1% chance per point to receive a random debuff you carry.

data.name: Empathic Link
data.description: When an enemy dies, its debuffs have a 2% chance per point to pass to a random enemy within 6 metres.

data.name: Beacon of Despair
data.description: You radiate an aura that applies a random debuff to enemies within 6 metres every 3 seconds. The duration of those debuffs is increased by 4% per point.

data.name: Shared Agony
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health lost to damage over time per point.

data.name: Ceaseless
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Vessel of Plagues
data.description: You can carry twice as many unique debuffs, and debuffs on you deal 50% more damage to you.

data.name: Doctrine of Pain
data.description: You deal 4% more damage for each unique debuff on you.

data.name: Flagellant
data.description: Every debuff on you grants 5 Fervour per second for as long as it lasts.

data.name: Quickened
data.description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point.

data.name: Razor's Edge
data.description: +3% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point.

data.name: Defiance
data.description: +2% increased Retaliation per point.

data.name: Living on the Edge
data.description: While at or below 35% health, +2% increased damage per point.

data.name: Last Stand
data.description: While at or below 20% health, +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

data.name: The Catalyst
data.description: While at or below 5% health, your skills have a 5% chance per point not to go on cooldown.

data.name: Desperate Measures
data.description: While at or below 50% health, +1% increased Movement Speed per point.

data.name: The Breaking Point
data.description: Dropping below 50% health converts all damage you take into Bleeding over 5 seconds. The conversion lasts 3 seconds, increased by 5% per point, and cannot happen more than once every 10 seconds.

data.name: Unstable Aura
data.description: While at or below 10% health, you release a nova every 5 seconds dealing damage equal to 1% of your missing health per point to enemies within 6 metres.

data.name: Bloodletting
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

data.name: Threadbare
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: The Edge
data.description: While at or below 20% health you take 25% less damage and your Fervour does not decrease.

data.name: Point of No Return
data.description: You cannot be healed above 50% of your maximum health, but you deal 25% more damage.

data.name: Low Life
data.description: While at or below 35% health you gain 10 Fervour per second.

data.name: The First Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Iron Will, but For the Soul
options.description: You can no longer be killed by physical damage, but 50% of all physical damage you take is converted to chaos damage.

options.name: The Unbreakable, but For the Mind
options.description: You can no longer be stunned or frozen, but your Mana and Energy Shield no longer regenerate naturally.

options.name: Water to Blood
options.description: You no longer have a mana pool. All maximum mana is converted into added maximum health, and every ability costs health instead of mana.

data.name: The Second Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: The Scourge of Flesh, but For the Self
options.description: Your attacks and spells have a 10% chance to inflict a stack of Withered on enemies, but every third skill you cast inflicts a stack of Withered on you.

options.name: The Immortal Champion, but For the Weak
options.description: Dropping below 50% health grants immunity to all damage for 5 seconds, but you deal 50% less damage while it lasts. This cannot happen more than once every 60 seconds.

options.name: The Void Embrace, but For the Sanity
options.description: For each Void item you have equipped you gain 50% increased chaos damage and lose 10% of your maximum health.

data.name: The Third Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Reaper's Gambit, but For the End
options.description: When you would drop to 0 health you are restored to full health instead, but you die if you take any damage in the next 10 seconds. This cannot happen more than once every 180 seconds.

options.name: The Unyielding, but For the World
options.description: You are immune to all debuffs and crowd control, but you cannot receive buffs from other players or from city upgrades.

options.name: The Cataclysmic Echo, but For the Soul
options.description: Each dungeon modifier in the dungeon you are in has a 10% chance to apply to you as a buff and a 25% chance to apply to you as a curse for the rest of that run.

data.name: The Final Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: The Martyr, but For the Flesh
options.description: All damage you take is also dealt to every enemy within 12 metres, but your Health Regeneration is set to zero.

options.name: Apotheosis, but For the Mind
options.description: Your Fervour has no maximum, but you take 1% more damage for every 100 Fervour you hold.

options.name: The Undying, but For the End
options.description: You cannot die while you hold Fervour. Lethal damage instead consumes all of it and leaves you at 1 health. You cannot gain Fervour for 20 seconds afterwards.

data.name: Blood Coin
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

data.name: Deeper Cuts
data.description: Your skills also cost 1% of your maximum health per point, in addition to any other cost. This cost generates Fervour like any other.

data.name: Ready Blood
data.description: +2% increased maximum Health per point.

data.name: Deferred Payment
data.description: 10% per point of the health a skill costs is not taken when the skill is used. It is taken 3 seconds later.

data.name: Compound Interest
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for every 5% of your maximum health you currently owe.

data.name: Rolling Debt
data.description: Paying a health cost while one is still owed extends the delay on what is owed by 0.5 seconds per point, to a maximum of 3 seconds.

data.name: The Reckoning
data.description: Health costs are never taken. They accumulate as a debt. You deal 1% more damage for every 2% of your maximum health that you owe, and the debt is cleared only by killing an enemy. If your debt ever exceeds your current health, you die.

data.name: Blood Rush
data.description: +2% increased damage per point for 2 seconds after you pay a health cost.

data.name: Sanguine Momentum
data.description: Each health cost paid within 3 seconds of the last grants a stack, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased attack and cast speed per point.

data.name: Grand Tithe
data.description: A skill whose health cost is above 10% of your maximum health deals 4% increased damage per point.

data.name: Exsanguinate
data.description: Every skill costs an additional 15% of your current health, and every skill deals 40% more damage. A cost taken from current health cannot reduce it below 1.

data.name: Staunch
data.description: The Fervour removed by your own health regeneration is reduced by 5% per point.

data.name: Deep Reserves
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Blood Tithe
data.description: You gain 30% more Fervour from health spent as an ability cost, and 50% less Fervour from health lost to damage.
